title: Codex plugin manifest (local compatibility schema)
$comment: LOCAL COMPATIBILITY SCHEMA -- NOT AN OFFICIAL HOST SCHEMA. Host behaviour remains authoritative; this schema encodes only the subset of fields agent-harness relies on at M1, so it can catch our own mistakes early. A file passing this schema is not thereby guaranteed to be accepted by the host. Official documentation: https://developers.openai.com/plugins/build/plugins
description: Validates plugins/agent-harness/.codex-plugin/plugin.json at M1. No official Codex manifest validator was found (Q-IMPL-009), so this local schema is the documented substitute recorded in docs/compatibility.md.

name.$comment: Official-Documented: the vendor instructs using a stable plugin name in kebab-case, used as the plugin identifier and component namespace. Canonical kebab-case. The vendor states 'kebab-case, no spaces' and its validator rejects uppercase, spaces and special characters; rejection of leading, trailing and repeated hyphens is a Local-M1-Policy refinement of that term, not a separately published rule.

skills.$comment: Documented format is a single relative directory path STRING, e.g. './skills/'. An array is rejected: type:string makes that a schema violation rather than a silently accepted variant. The pattern also rejects absolute, drive-qualified, UNC, tilde, interpolated and parent-traversal paths.
